svg.title: The delivery gate: what blocks a merge
svg.desc: Diagram. A pull request goes through the delivery gate. Always blocking, in every mode: the exact frozen commit, an open non-draft pull request on the authorized base, required CI green, and the independent reviewer account approving that exact commit. Blocking by default and only warnings in owner mode: branch naming, one type label, an approved linked issue, conventional commits, no Co-Authored-By trailers, and pull request size. Then the leader merges with match-head-commit. Workers never merge, approve, force-push, write the default or protected branches, CI or git config, or read secrets.

svg.text: Owner mode (PANTER_OWNER_MODE=1) turns the dashed box into warnings. The red box and the worker limits never change.

svg.text: Without an independent reviewer configured, owner mode blocks every delivery.
